name: Asserted database association
study_design: Curated or literature-derived edges imported from secondary databases without an intervention or a direction measured in this study
causal_weight: Minimal; existence of a reported relationship
supports: That a relationship has been asserted in a source
cannot_show: Direction, effect size, or that the relationship occurs in the studied system

name: Replicated observational co-change
study_design: Concordant direction across independent human cohorts, single-cell and spatial localization, and disease-stratified comparison
causal_weight: Low to moderate; correlated change that remains confounded
supports: That a target changes with disease and the cell type or tissue where it is expressed
cannot_show: That the change causes the outcome or that confounding is removed

name: Curated physical or biochemical interaction
study_design: Validated docking with redock and DUD-E, and independently curated ligand-receptor pairs with secretion and receptor annotations
causal_weight: Moderate; a physical mechanism or contact
supports: A plausible physical binding or signaling interaction
cannot_show: An in-system measured effect or receptor activation

name: Interventional or perturbation evidence
study_design: Directed in silico knockout and overexpression with signal propagation, converging with independent LINCS L1000 signatures and high-throughput experimental targets
causal_weight: Highest available in this study; intervention-like and directional
cannot_show: That a model-based or external-context perturbation reproduces in vivo

name: Human genetic causal inference
study_design: Two-sample MR, Bayesian colocalization, and SMR with HEIDI using germline instruments
causal_weight: Strongest design for a human causal effect; the result here is null
supports: A germline causal effect when positive; here no positive support
cannot_show: Tissue-specific or local non-germline effects; a null is not evidence of absence
